title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas About the Role Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO. As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships. You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will: Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network. What You'll Do Drive revenue growth across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case. Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts. Build the East Coast startup sales team. Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers. Spot breakout companies early. Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms. Make venture investors a growth channel. Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages. Help shape the product roadmap. Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next. Adapt our sales process for startups. Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning. Balance short-term and long-term revenue. Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment. Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities. What You'll Bring 12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token Strong tie
